title: Fever Loops
summary: a seeded, looping maths-animation generator that writes PNG frames in plain Python, with a random seed it prints so a video can be remade
not_checked: how it looks (trippy, smoothness of motion, flashing comfort), how many building blocks there are, whether the loop closes for every seed (the seam check samples a few), the --mp4 path when ffmpeg is installed, palette details finer than the 3-unit tolerance, flag defaults and validation, the same frames on another machine or Python version, the speed of bigger renders
